title: Use ready formulas
summary: How to copy a ready-made formula, such as the GST in an amount, into your own Google Sheet.

steps.text: Click Shared sheets in the sidebar, then Ready formulas.
Find the one you want. Each says what it does in plain words. Click Copy.

image.description: The Ready formulas list: GST in an amount, Amount without GST, % of income, Change from last quarter, Flag if over an amount, and Days until the BAS is due, each with what it does, its formula and a Copy button. It says GST in an amount was copied.

steps.text: In your Google Sheet, click a cell and paste. Change the cells it points at, such as B2, to the ones with your figures.

sections.heading: In every workbook
paragraphs: Every workbook you publish has a Ready formulas tab with the same list, and a working example of each, so your accountant sees what you used.
GST in an amount is one eleventh of a price that includes GST, rounded to the cent, as the ATO works it out. It is never 10% of that price.

sections.heading: If something goes wrong
paragraphs: The formula shows as text in your sheet: make sure it starts with = and that you pasted it into a cell, not into a comment.
